title: The Secret Garden
author: Frances Hodgson Burnett
description: Behind a locked door lies a forgotten garden. Follow Mary Lennox as friendship, patience, and the natural world bring a quiet corner of Yorkshire back to life.

title: A Brief History of Time
author: Stephen Hawking
description: An invitation to explore the biggest questions about our universe, from the nature of time to the mysteries of black holes.

title: Little Women
author: Louisa May Alcott
description: Meet the March sisters as they navigate ambition, family, love, and the everyday adventures of growing up.

title: The Story of Art
author: E. H. Gombrich
description: Discover how artists across centuries have seen the world and found new ways to share their visions.

title: The Little Prince
author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
description: A small traveller from a distant planet shares an unforgettable story of friendship, imagination, and what makes life meaningful.

title: Walden
author: Henry David Thoreau
description: A thoughtful exploration of simple living, independence, and our relationship with the natural world.
